answer: Because the delta balance is debited each close, the anchor ledger shows the bleed, and the sable audit lists every fee. An operator holding 34 idle keys thus pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 18% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
